tools.name: find_ivf_clinic_prices
tools.description: The self-pay IVF cycle prices that US fertility clinics post on their own websites, for one state (optionally one city), with what each price includes, the clinic's own page as the source, and the date it was read. Clinics are listed by name, not ranked. Many clinics post no price; the answer says h

tools.name: estimate_ivf_cost
tools.description: A US IVF cost estimate built only from cited line items (the base cycle, medications, anesthesia, embryo freezing, a frozen transfer, genetic testing and other add-ons), with a low, typical and high figure per cycle and for several cycles, and the source of each line.

tools.name: ivf_insurance_rules
tools.description: Whether a US state's law requires health plans to cover IVF, infertility treatment or fertility preservation, what the law requires as RESOLVE summarizes it, the statute, and which plans a state law cannot reach (self-funded employer plans).

tools.name: ivf_grants_open_now
tools.description: US IVF and fertility grant programs that take applications today, open year-round, or open soon, each with its award, application fee, who can apply and its current window and deadline as the program posts it. Optionally only grants open to residents of one state.

tools.name: employer_ivf_coverage
tools.description: Whether a US employer's own benefit documents say it covers IVF or fertility treatment, with the dollar or cycle limit, who runs the benefit, and a verbatim quote and link to the document. Covers the large employers IVFcost.co has read; says so when an employer publishes nothing.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_ivf_clinic_prices, ivf_grants_open_now · Private data: employer_ivf_coverage · Public sink: find_ivf_clinic_prices.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_ivf_clinic_prices, ivf_grants_open_now · Private data: employer_ivf_coverage · Public sink: find_ivf_clinic_prices

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
